rows.en: It worked! We got Annie inside!

Listen up, everyone! The Japan of 10 years from now will be in your hands to rule!

You are geniuses! The super elite! Drink this Fuuma Hormone Drink and eat Madako Food!

And then… some of you will become Beast Alien Doublemen, and some of you may even become rare beasts… er, I mean, Fushigi Beasts!

In any case… your intellect and strength will develop remarkably! Come on, come on, drink up, eat up!
(They mean to plant Makuu's, Madou's and Fuuma's ideology and strength in the children, and have them rule Japan in the future…)
Come on, come on, once you've eaten, let's exercise! And after exercising, drink some more!
No! You mustn't drink that stuff!
Teacher… What are you saying?
…!? The woman Space Sheriff!
That's right…!
Annie, the woman Space Sheriff!!
Curse you… impudent girl!
Masaru! You mustn't eat that stuff! Stop it!

Ha ha ha… It's no use, Annie!

Our educational policy has soaked them to the bone. That Masaru in particular will make a fine leader! He's one of our Makuu commander candidates!
Hanpen! You're the one who kidnapped Masaru and the children, aren't you? Why would you do this!?

Hanpen…?

I see… So that's what this man is called?
What do you mean?
This is what I mean!
I simply borrowed this man's appearance so I could kidnap the children without causing a fuss!
Hyah!
Ugh…!?
Put the woman in the secret base's cell! I'll dispose of her later!
Annie! Annie!
What's wrong, Shaider?
The transmitter's signal has vanished… Something's happened to Annie! The location is SSP230!
SSP230? That's a remote little island! Let's hurry!
Throw her into the sea and make her food for the sharks!
Yes, ma'am…
Good, throw her in!
Shuwaa!
The Space Sheriffs!?
Grr… They've sniffed us out already!? Don't flinch, Subjugate!
Hold it! Toh!!
I've rescued all the children!

You, still alive!?

Grr… I'll take care of you all at once! Subjugate!!
You won't escape!! Prepare yourselves!!
The entire universe is made up of the Heavenly World, the Earthly World and the Fushigi World…
Still… this computer age is something to think about, huh? It sure is convenient, but…
No matter how convenient they are, we mustn't become slaves to machines… is that it?
Huh? Wait, do you mean me? …Ah
No matter how convenient they are, you mustn't become a slave to machines.
Mm… It means you shouldn't spend all your time playing games like that!

Ha ha ha…

Masaru, next time play with your big brother here!

Okay…

But… I'm the one who gets to beat Gill Hakaider!
All riiight, I'm counting on you!
Shoketsu!!
You look like you're having fun, Shaider? You're not bad at all.
C-cut it out…
Even the invincible Shaider is just a bashful big brother in front of children.
But Annie really shone today, didn't she?
Protect the children's smiles. Shoketsu, Space Sheriff Shaider!
Kyaaaaah…
Grr, you Space Sheriffs! Yet again… Kuh… How bitter!
Defeat Fushigi Beast Umiumi and all Miracler Soldiers!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers and Kama Doublers!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers and Kama Doublers! Also, take over the Japan Future Electronics Industries factory!!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Fightlow Soldiers and General Guiler, and get Annie inside the Super Genius Cram School!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Fightlow Soldiers, Miracler Soldiers and General Guiler, and get Annie inside the Super Genius Cram School!
Defeat Fuuma of the Fushigi World and rescue Annie!
Defeat Beast Alien Doubleman and all of Fuuma of the Fushigi World!
Annie is defeated

Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha ha!

With this, we can finally revive Shadow Moon!
Ohohohoho… This time, we won't let anyone interfere!

Everyone… What are you laughing about? Hm…

Don't tell me… you mean to revive Shadow Moon…?

Exactly!

Until now, those Riders have given us no end of trouble, but once Shadow Moon is revived, they'll be no problem at all!

At last… the day of Gorgom's world domination is drawing near!

And that's not all! Once Shadow Moon is revived… you'll be thrown out!

Better tuck your tail and crawl back to your coffin while you still can!
What!?

Stop it! We have no time to waste on the likes of him!

Begin preparations to infuse the life energy at once!

Curse them… I won't let them have their way!

If it's come to this, I'll defeat Shadow Moon in one stroke and take the seat of the next Creation King into my own hands…
Who's there? Who summoned me?
It is I, Lord Swordsaint Birugenia…

…!?

Who are you?
I am an envoy from the battle-fleet nation Naager, called Apfaron the Evil Scholar… a nameless merchant.
And what does a merchant from this Naager want?

It was I who begged Lord Creation King to break your seal…

Because I very much want you, Lord Birugenia, to take up the Satan Saber.

What!?

You're telling me to seize the Satan Saber that sleeps deep in this cave… granted only to the Creation King!?

Whoa…

Lord Creation King… What do you intend?

What!?

Go through this cave and take the sword…? And defeat the Kamen Rider and become the next Creation King…?

Hurry, Lord Birugenia…

You must obtain the Satan Saber before the Three Archpriests revive the Century King! You are the next Creation King!

Leave it to me… I have a fine idea! Heh heh heh…
Feeling the pressure of the Three Archpriests' words, Birugenia set foot into the cave infested with the dead that lies within Gorgom.

U09392: ハンペンさん rendered "Hanpen".
U09397/U09399: Hessler (female in Shaider) — "her" for Annie; Hessler's own gender not needed.
U09409/U09412: 征伐 rendered "Subjugate!" as before.
U09417: [HERO2]'s guilty reaction (he's the one gaming), kept as fragment "…Ah".
U09421: ギルハカイダー rendered "Gill Hakaider" (a video-game boss here).
U09437: [ja] rendered "Beast Alien Doubleman and all of Fuuma of the Fushigi World".
